name: admin_state
desc: The administrative state of the object or policy. - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`

name: deletion_policy
desc: What happens on the device when objects managed by the resource are removed. `delete` deletes the object on destroy, including any configuration not managed by Terraform, and deletes single child objects once none of their attributes are configured anymore, unless the device holds other entries below them. `reset` deletes the objects created by the resource on destroy, resets the managed attribut…

name: device
desc: A device name from the provider configuration.

name: vnis
desc: List of EVPN VNIs. - Map key: `encap` - Encapsulation. Possible values are `unknown`, `vlan-XX` or `vxlan-XX`.

name: vnis[*].route_distinguisher
desc: Route Distinguisher. value in NX-OS DME format.

name: vnis[*].route_target_directions
desc: List of EVPN VNI route target directions. - Map key: `type` - Type. - Key choices: `import`, `export`

name: vnis[*].route_target_directions[*].route_targets
desc: List of EVPN VNI route target entries. - Map key: `route_target` - Route Target. in NX-OS DME format.

name: vnis[*].table_map
desc: Route-map name for table-map command to filter routes.

name: vnis[*].table_map_filter
desc: Filter option used with table-map configuration for selective route download.
